column1: # Shot types for test-video2. One line per contact. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Milestone 1 already knows WHERE every contact is and WHO hit it -- those are your own
# labels. This asks only WHAT stroke it was.
# One preview clip per contact is in outputs/test-video2/shots/previews/, named
# shot<id>_r<rally>_f<frame>_<hitter>.mp4. Each runs from the previous contact to the next,
# so you see the shuttle arrive and leave, and the one to name is marked with a red border
# and the word CONTACT. Nothing on the video shows any prediction.
# shot is one of: smash drop clear lift drive net serve other uncertain
# Use uncertain freely. It is recorded and then left out of the scoring rather than guessed.
# The frame and hitter below are filled in already. Add the shot type after the frame.
t 870 drop shot should be from the far player not the near player
t 1622 drop shot was from the backend but shuttle dropped to the front of the court
t 2689 smash but this was from far
t 4510 drop this should be hit by the far player
t 5060 net but this was hit by the near player
t 7227 uncertain   written as "?" by the labeller
t 7248 uncertain   written as "?" by the labeller
